body.title: Add the sc4 experience slot factory — uxPickRef and uxBuildMockSlot (INERT)
body.summary: The sc4 plumbing half, split out of the original t2 by the critique. Add uxPickRef and uxBuildMockSlot as exact mirrors of S003's shipped dgPickRef/dgBuildDiagramSlot, instantiating sc4's CompanionSlotFactory<TRecord> over the uxDefinition record and passing the bound t4 decided. Still INERT — nothing calls it until t6 — so the slot's three-state logic and its ref discrimination are proved before a single pixel moves. The critique's uxPickRef gap closes here: this Story is the FIRST time two slots read the same `companions` array, and S003 established the refs cannot be told apart naively, since three daemon renderers all stamp `kind:'diagram-mermaid'`.
acceptanceChecks: PICKER PARTITION (critique): over one fixture carrying a ux-mock ref AND all three diagram-kind refs, uxPickRef selects the ux-mock ref and ONLY it, and s3's dgPickRef over that same fixture still selects exactly what it selected before. The two pickers PARTITION the array rather than overlap — a loose match would hand the mock a diagram's label and link-out, producing a slot that renders, looks plausible, and points the reviewer at the wrong companion
THE INVERSE: a companions array of diagram refs only yields NO ux ref — which is what routes ac3's dominant path to 'absent'
The three sc4 states are returned correctly from the factory in isolation: absent / rendered / unshowable, with `linkOut` optional on both non-absent states as sc4 shipped it
`body` is handled as sc4's widened `unknown`, matching sc2's shipped StructuredRenderer<T> rather than the HLD sketch
The slot's label comes from sc4's companionVisualKind applied to the ux ref — never hard-coded, which is what lets t6 prove the two slots are distinguishable
The depth bound is PASSED IN, not re-declared — one named constant, t4's value, no second copy
The surface is STILL unchanged: the emitted shell differs from t2's pinned baseline only by the added source text, and nothing calls the factory

tests.name: PICKER PARTITION: over a fixture carrying a ux-mock ref and all three diagram-kind refs, uxPickRef selects the ux-mock ref and only it, and dgPickRef's selection is unchanged
a companions array of diagram refs only yields NO ux ref
the factory returns sc4's three states correctly in isolation: absent / rendered / unshowable
ref present + record absent returns 'unshowable' with a reason NAMING what was referenced, and linkOut offered
a malformed record with a ref present returns 'unshowable' rather than a broken card
the absent state carries no label, body or link
body: [] and a malformed record are treated as ABSENT
the slot label is derived from the ref's title via companionVisualKind, never invented per call
body is handled as sc4's widened unknown, matching the shipped StructuredRenderer<T>
the depth bound is passed in, not re-declared — still one named constant
all FIVE source strings still parse together in one scope after the factory's names join
